body:
Owner: nothing to do. The orchestrator lands docs/CL26-kit.patch on anlonlt/board main. On the web, it makes the create_session call that a completed step now hands it for the step's review.

## Launchers
`_launcher()` in kit.py picks the runtime: web gets the create_session call; agy where agy runs; `claude --bg` where claude is; kit.cli only if its binary is on PATH. With none it says NOT STARTED and gives the prompt's path, never an OSError. Used by review (step complete), `kit.py launch` (part) and handover.py (orchestrator, clerk). On the web, handover no longer kills CLAUDE_PID, which would have ended the session with no successor.

## The single-dot Stop hook
Neither platform lets a hook see the text before it is shown: Claude Code's Stop and agy's PostInvocation/Stop both run after. So the rule now comes before the turn (UserPromptSubmit/PreInvocation) when the owner did not type it: a background role, a session's message, a timer, or the kit's launch line. Harmonize's own hook took that short launch line for his question; fixed.

## Item 3: launch repo guard
The orchestrator guard on create_session refuses a part whose source_url is not its step's repo: the repo of the attached board holding its post (local copy), else a known clone holding its prompt file. CL25 and CL26 were launched on harmonize for a board step and could not push. With nothing to check against, it lets the launch through. agy has no create_session, so this guard is Claude Code only.

## Also
run_all_tests clears the runtime markers: run from the web, two old tests launched as web. A free-memory flake in test_resume_attached_boards is pinned. Both say-it-once rules in WHAT-NOT-TO-BREAK are kept.
handoff: Land docs/CL26-kit.patch (2 commits: 0968405 launchers + hook, 0d18383 create_session repo guard) on kit main. On the web a completed step now returns 'review ... NOT STARTED ... create_session {...}': the orchestrator makes that call. A kit step is launched with source_url anlonlt/board: run `kit.py step new` in the kit's clone.
not_checked: No real review was started end to end (web: the orchestrator's create_session; CLI: claude --bg tested with a fake binary). An agy device not tried. The kit commit is not on anlonlt/board main: this session cannot push there (patch kept). The guard was not tried on the orchestrator's real local copy.
title: the review launcher works on every platform
verdict: Every launcher (review, part, clerk, orchestrator) now uses the runtime it runs in and says NOT STARTED instead of crashing; no platform lets a hook stop text before it shows, so the single-dot rule now comes before the turn.
